name: Forecasting (example 2)
source:
local ALPHA = 0.2
local COVER = 3
local SAFETY = 0

return {
  on_review = function(ctx)
    local here, memory = ctx.here, ctx.memory
    local stock = here.stock.Goods or 0
    local backorders = here.backorders and here.backorders.Goods or 0
    local position = stock - backorders
    for _, order in ipairs(here.on_order or {}) do
      if order.resource == "Goods" then
        position = position + order.amount
      end
    end
    if memory.after ~= nil then
      local used = memory.after - position
      if memory.forecast == nil then
        memory.forecast = used
      else
        memory.forecast = ALPHA * used + (1 - ALPHA) * memory.forecast
      end
      ctx.record("demand", used / 1000)
      ctx.record("forecast", memory.forecast / 1000)
    end
    local target = math.floor((memory.forecast or 0) * COVER + SAFETY + 0.5)
    local amount = 0
    if target > position then
      amount = target - position
      ctx.order("Goods", amount)
    end
    memory.after = position + amount
  end,
}

name: Fixed-route delivery (example 2)
source:
return {
  on_review = function(ctx)
    local target = 0
    for _, id in ipairs(ctx.station_order) do
      local station = ctx.stations[id]
      if station ~= ctx.here then
        target = target + station.capacity.Fuel
      end
    end
    local position = ctx.here.stock.Fuel
    for _, order in ipairs(ctx.here.on_order or {}) do
      position = position + order.amount
    end
    if target > position then
      ctx.order("Fuel", target - position)
    end
  end,
  on_stop = function(ctx)
    local here, truck = ctx.here, ctx.vehicle
    if #here.suppliers > 0 then
      local short, passed = 0, { [here.id] = true }
      for _, stop in ipairs(truck.route.ahead) do
        if passed[stop.station.id] then
          break
        end
        passed[stop.station.id] = true
        short = short + stop.station.capacity.Fuel - stop.station.stock.Fuel
      end
      local wanted = short - truck.cargo.Fuel
      local amount = math.min(wanted, here.stock.Fuel, truck.space.Fuel)
      if amount > 0 then
        ctx.load("Fuel", amount)
      end
    else
      local room = here.capacity.Fuel - here.stock.Fuel
      local amount = math.min(truck.cargo.Fuel, room)
      if amount > 0 then
        ctx.unload("Fuel", amount)
      end
    end
  end,
}

name: ops.balance (example 2)
source:
local policy = {}

local function stores(station, resource)
  for _, id in ipairs(station.resources) do
    if id == resource then
      return true
    end
  end
  return false
end

function policy.on_stop(ctx)
  local here = ctx.here
  for _, resource in ipairs(here.resources) do
    local total, count = 0, 0
    for _, id in ipairs(ctx.station_order) do
      local other = ctx.stations[id]
      if stores(other, resource) then
        total = total + other.stock[resource]
        count = count + 1
      end
    end
    local target = math.floor(total / count)
    local difference = here.stock[resource] - target
    if difference > 0 then
      ctx.load(resource, difference)
    elseif difference < 0 then
      ctx.unload(resource, -difference)
    end
  end
end

return policy
